description: This file is a shell script for testing 'git update-ref' error handling and reference operations. It contains test cases for various reference lock scenarios, error conditions, and conflicts in a Git repository, utilizing functions like test_update_rejected and df_test to simulate and validate reference updates, deletions, symbolic references, and error responses.

methods.name: test_update_rejected
methods.description: A test utility function that creates references, possibly packs them, then attempts to create conflicting references to test error handling for reference conflicts.

methods.name: df_test
methods.description: A test function that performs add and delete operations on references, including symbolic references, with various conflict scenarios and error validation.
